objective: For a specified boundary on a checked refutation, replace the supplied final AND grouping by a cheaper grouping with polynomial overhead; determine the four-input bound, the scalable interface and the cost measure.
status: Proved: A checked four-input AND producer can be regrouped with polynomial overhead for every final-only cut that also keeps incoming parent statements public. For an arbitrary number of inputs, recompiling the standard AND interface and its supplied public derivations preserves one shared suffix with polynomial overhead. The balanced four-input example needs five affine parts and the chain needs four.
title: Replace the AND producer behind its final output
